summary: Iteration 32 — Backend 35/35 PASS (11 new iter32 tests + 24 iter31 regression). Frontend: password toggles work on client-login, client-register, admin-login (PasswordInput component is solid). /admin/warm-leads page renders perfectly with all required testids, 16 warm-lead rows, stats grid, filters, search, refresh button — all functional. ❌ CRITICAL FRONTEND BUG: /app/frontend/src/lib/useCompanyContext.js calls `clientApi.get('/companies/me')` but `clientApi` is a FUNCTION (clientApi(token) → axios instance). The call throws TypeError, is silently swallowed by the bare `catch {}`, so the hook always returns `{company: null, role: null}`. Result: ManageTeamPanel ALWAYS shows the 'No team set up yet.' empty state for every user (verified with testclient@bybloomlabs.com whose backend /api/companies/me clearly returns a valid company + admin role + owner=true). Same bug affects ManageTeamPanel.jsx lines 42 + 56 (invite-send + role-change use `clientApi.post(...)`).

ui_bugs.issue: clientApi is imported as if it's an axios instance but it's actually a factory function that requires a token. Hook silently returns null company → empty state always shown. Manage Team feature is completely non-functional in UI even though backend works perfectly.
ui_bugs.selector: manage-team-panel (never rendered — falls through to 'No team set up yet' empty state which lacks data-testid)

ui_bugs.issue: When company is null, the early-return JSX does NOT carry data-testid='manage-team-panel'. Even when this code path is legitimate (truly no company), tests can't assert the panel mounted.

integration_issues.issue: Backend /api/companies/me returns the full team + role for testclient@bybloomlabs.com, but the frontend hook cannot consume it (see useCompanyContext bug above). End-to-end manage-team is broken.

action_items: FIX useCompanyContext.js: change `import { clientApi } from '@/lib/clientAuth'` + `clientApi.get('/companies/me')` to use the factory pattern. Either (a) `import { useClientAuth, clientApi } from ...; const { token } = useClientAuth(); const { data } = await clientApi(token).get('/companies/me');`, or (b) export a pre-bound `clientApiWithAuth` instance from clientAuth.js that pulls token from local storage.

FIX ManageTeamPanel.jsx lines 42 + 56: same factory bug for `clientApi.post('/company-setup/invites', ...)` and `clientApi.post('/companies/me/members/.../role', ...)`. Use `clientApi(token).post(...)`.
OPTIONAL: add `data-testid="manage-team-panel"` to the empty-state early-return so tests can still assert the panel mounted even when no company exists.
Remove the bare `catch {}` in useCompanyContext.js OR at minimum `console.error(e)` so this class of bug is discoverable in dev.
Consider adding a frontend lint rule / unit test that catches TypeError on hook init — this slipped through because the catch swallowed it.
critical_code_review_comments: useCompanyContext.js — wrong usage of clientApi (it's a token-bound factory, not an axios instance). Critical functional bug.
ManageTeamPanel.jsx — same wrong-usage bug repeated in 2 places (invite send + role change).
useCompanyContext.js — bare `catch {}` masked the TypeError. Always log the error in dev builds.

reactivation_crons.py — both ticks are idempotent (watermark gate works on the 2nd call). Mongo $or with `$exists: false` is correct. Email failures are caught and don't poison the loop.
server.py — both new cron jobs registered at 09:00 and 10:00 UTC. Scheduler started cleanly (/api/health 200). No deferred-warmup regression.
company_setup_routes.py — owner role-lock now rejects ANY role change on is_owner=true (both demote-to-viewer AND set-to-admin return 400). Confirmed by test_iteration_32 tests.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is rock-solid. Re-run test_iteration_32.py + test_iteration_31.py as the regression suite. The ONLY action item is the clientApi-factory misuse in useCompanyContext.js + ManageTeamPanel.jsx — once fixed, re-verify by logging in as testclient@bybloomlabs.com → /portal → Profile tab → should see Manage Team card with 'Test Co' company name, owner badge on testclient row, and (since role=admin) an invite card. Other password-toggle fields not directly verified (set-password, invite-password, nifty-manual-token-input, gdrive-credentials-client-secret, invite-password) but they all use the same PasswordInput component which proved correct on 3 verified fields.
rca of the issue: useCompanyContext was authored against an outdated/imagined clientApi API (instance-style) but the actual export is a `clientApi(token)` factory. ESLint did not catch this because clientApi is a function and `clientApi.get` would only fail at runtime. The bare `catch {}` then swallowed the TypeError. Same author copy-pasted the wrong pattern into ManageTeamPanel.jsx for the write paths.
